pairs.subject: engine-host-contract
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/worker.rs:254 Worker jobs are durable queue records that are re-queued and resumed from a checkpoint across restarts, which is the job-coordination animal the golden path explicitly excludes; a search of crates/ for HostHooks, JobExecutor, microtask, macrotask and ModuleLoader found nothing.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/worker.rs:254 Jobs survive restarts as stored rows, so there are no in-memory engine job executors.
